newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish 1996 wholesales volume rises 2.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Finnish 1996 wholesales volume rises 2.1 pct.

text.p: The volume of Finnish wholesales rose 2.1 percent year-on-year in 1996 and the value excluding value-added tax (VAT) of these sales rose 3.7 percent, Statistics Finland (SF) said a statement on Tuesday.
The volume of retail sales rose 4.1 percent year-on-year in 1996 and the value excluding VAT of these sales rose 4.8 percent, SF said.

"Car trade was the best performer ... last year both in wholesales and retail sales," it said, adding that the volume of car wholesales rose 8.4 percent and the volume of car retail sales rose 15.7 percent.
SF said the volume of wholesales rose 3.0 percent year-on-year in December and the value excluding value-added tax (VAT) of these sales rose 5.4 percent.
The volume of retail sales rose 3.9 percent year-on-year in December and the value excluding VAT of these sales rose 4.9 percent, SF said.
